questions.q: At what age was Usamah bin Zaid appointed to lead the Prophet's SAW last expedition?
questions.explain: Usamah, son of Zaid and Umm Ayman, was appointed at 16.

questions.q: Who was the first person to believe in the Prophet SAW?
questions.explain: Khadijah was the first to believe and she comforted him.

questions.q: To whom did Khadijah take the Prophet SAW after the first revelation?
questions.explain: Waraqah was Khadijah's cousin, an expert in earlier scriptures.

questions.q: What old name for Jibril did Waraqah use?
questions.explain: An-Namus is the old name for Jibril who brought revelation to the prophets.

questions.q: Who was the first child to believe?
questions.explain: Ali lived with the Prophet SAW and Khadijah, saw them pray and joined them.

questions.q: What did Ali say before embracing Islam?
options: He wanted to ask Abu Talib first
questions.explain: Ali said he needed to ask his father first. We too should ask our parents' permission.

questions.q: Why did Abu Bakr believe immediately?
options: Because he had known his friend's honesty since childhood
Because Abu Talib told him to
questions.explain: Abu Bakr believed as soon as he was told the Prophet had been appointed, because he knew his honesty.
False. Abu Talib told Ali to follow the Prophet SAW but did not embrace Islam himself.

questions.q: Prayer was at first twice a day before it became five times.
questions.explain: True. Jibril taught wudu and prayer, twice a day at the start.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.
questions.explain: He ran home, met Waraqah, Waraqah died, Ali joined the prayer and Abu Bakr believed.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: Family ties from the same womb

questions.explain: Silaturahim is family ties, An-Namus is Jibril's old name, a fortune teller is a diviner, and wudu is purification before prayer.

questions.q: You know something good and want your good friends to join in. What example does Abu Bakr give?
options: Invite your good friends right away
questions.explain: Abu Bakr promptly invited his good friends to join Islam.
